title: Pure section component of normalized coefficient transition
statement: Let l be prime, E and L finite extensions of Q_l, ι : E \to L a Q_l-algebra map, and g : X \to Y an isomorphism of schemes on which l is invertible in every residue field. Fix completion reindexing data D,D′ and completed tensor reindexing data T,T′ satisfying their laws. There exists transition data S, with ordinary scalar/reindexing isomorphism, normalized scalar models at X and Y and preservation of intrinsic constructibility. For every module M on Y, object U of X.ProEt, section x of M on g(U), and completed L coefficient a on g(U), the ordinary comparison sends c_L(a) tensor x on U to a tensor x on g(U). The notions are those of [def-pod-completion-reindex-models], [def-pod-completion-reindex-coefficient-transition] and [def-trf-integral-comparison-realization-models].

proof.text: At each quotient, naturality of the constant sheaf scalar map gives the coefficient square. Equality after all quotient projections gives the completed square. Apply restrictionSquare and adjointSquare from the isomorphism reduction module to the scalar adjunctions; both reindexing functors are equivalences. Evaluating the mate identity on sections and using the unit tensor formula gives the tensor-one identity. Linearity and the inverse coefficient map give the arbitrary coefficient formula. Choose the normalized primitive quotient scalar models. Transfer completed scalar constructibility along scalarCompletionIso on a derived complete input.

theorem podReindexingTensorCoefficientTransition_pure
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ Y) [IsIso g]
    [∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)]
    [∀ y : Y, Invertible (l : Y.residueField y)]
    (D : PodCompletionReindex l E g) (_hD : PodCompletionReindex.Laws l E g D)
    (T : PodCompletedTensorReindex l E g D)
    (_hT : PodCompletedTensorReindex.Laws l E g D T)
    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra ℚ_[l] L] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] L]
    (ι : E →ₐ[ℚ_[l]] L)
    (D' : PodCompletionReindex l L g) (_hD' : PodCompletionReindex.Laws l L g D')
    (T' : PodCompletedTensorReindex l L g D')
    (_hT' : PodCompletedTensorReindex.Laws l L g D' T') :
    ∃ S : PodReindexCoefficientTransition l E L ι g D D',
      ∀ (M : scalarReductionSource l E Y) (U : X.ProEt)
        (x : M.val.obj (op ((proEtaleIsoPostcompose g).obj U)))
        (a : (completedIntegralCoefficientSheafUnrestricted l L Y).obj.obj
          (op ((proEtaleIsoPostcompose g).obj U))),
        (S.ordinary.hom.app M).val.app (op U)
            (integralOrdinaryTensorSection l E L ι X
              ((isoReductionIntegralInverse l E g).obj M) (op U)
              ((isoReductionCompletedMap l L g).hom.hom.app (op U) a) x) =
          integralOrdinaryTensorSection l E L ι Y M
            (op ((proEtaleIsoPostcompose g).obj U)) a x
